summary: FidelityManager configuration validation still dereferences caller-provided PolicyConfig before proving it is primitive plain data. FidelityManager.new() calls copyConfig(config) before validation, and evaluatePolicy() validates an optional config after field access begins inside validateConfig. A metatable-backed config can therefore execute __index during rejection or synthesize accepted policy values. Active primary PR #274 hardens PolicyInputs and numeric scalars but does not cover PolicyConfig's no-execute boundary.
evidence: Current main src/shared/Physics/FidelityManager.luau copies caller config by direct field access before validateConfig in FidelityManager.new().
Current evaluatePolicy accepts an optional config and validateConfig dereferences its fields without first rejecting metatable-backed tables.
PR #274 patch adds metatable/no-execute checks for PolicyInputs and primitive numeric policy/timestamp values, but contains no PolicyConfig metatable/plain-data preflight.
